The main takeaway from our work is that
the effect of stress (density and nutrients) on plant allometry, branching, and fruit production is not uniform and that the effect of density on allometry is more important than that of nutrients.
the allometric relationships are not fixed and that the plant form is not only determined by competition but also affected by the environment.
